menus.label: Verified branch breakfast menu

items.name: Thick-cut yellowtail and daikon breakfast set

menus.note: Tax included under UMAGA’s explicit tax policy; operator opening release corroborates the four fish sets. Set includes side dishes, soup, pickles and clay-pot white rice; rice refills are free. Fifty-minute seating, entry exactly at booked time. Cash and credit cards only. Children must be able to eat the same meal as adults. Contact the restaurant about arrangements for seven or more; booking page says “2席” and the exact booking-unit meaning needs confirmation. More than fifteen minutes late without contact may be cancelled. Extra-egg ¥200 is explicit; other supplements are not inferred from photographs.

openingHours.hours: 08:00–14:00; last order 13:00; reservation required, fifty-minute seating
